mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during FEDFUNDS < 0.5% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000 jobs per month, the labor market's strength predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% MoM signals supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of months with INDPRO MoM growth > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding $500 billion YoY indicates strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both increase by more than 0.5% and 2%, respectively, within a 3-month window, the mechanism predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with inflation pressures
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained UNRATE above 6% indicates labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during UNRATE > 6% periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: HOUST growth exceeding 10% YoY signals housing market strength, but if accompanied by a > 2% increase in CPIAUCSL, the mechanism predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to inflation concerns.
regime_hint: late-cycle housing market boom with inflation risks
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.
